label: lanthivirin system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a lanthivirin lanthipeptide biosynthetic gene cluster that can confer anti-phage activity in a native Streptomyces context and after heterologous expression of complete lanthivirin systems.
observations: Lanthivirin branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual lanthivirin genes or Lph proteins, isolated lanthipeptide biosynthesis proteins, anti-phage activity outside a complete lanthivirin biosynthetic gene cluster, the DefenseFinder Lanthiphage profile rows, source database rows naming one Lanthiphage model, unresolved mature lanthivirin effector activity, and other phage-defense systems.
